The margin over break-even is narrow and backed by one comparison book only.","model_case":"Projects 12.1 points on about 26 minutes. Even the median clears 9.5. The weakness is a fairly wide points distribution at modest minutes, so a short-minutes night falls under easily.","price_case":"At -120, the main line needs roughly six-in-eleven. The model is only slightly above that, and the other book implies nearly the same. This is thin value at best, not broad consensus.","context_case":"The snapshot shows a Wizards frontcourt teammate out, which might add minutes for Sarr. The model does not account for that, and Sarr's own absence from the table does not establish health.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"The book and the model nearly agree, so the edge depends on small modeling details. Sarr's minutes are moderate, and a blowout loss or foul trouble could cap his scoring. It is unclear whether the market already reflects this.","kind":"injury","direction":"supports","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"04bd0dbd023f68038f8ec29f","status":"concern","assessment":{"verdict":"wait","reason":"The under leans on a skewed distribution while the projected mean of 19.6 sits above 18.5. Cunningham's game-time status could swing Jenkins's usage, and the model does not adjust for teammate absences.","model_case":"Projects 19.6 mean and a median of 18 on about 34 minutes. The under only edges ahead because of right skew. With several Detroit guards and bigs listed out, opportunity risk tilts toward the over, outside the model's inputs.","price_case":"At +110, break-even is a bit under one-in-two. The model barely exceeds that, and the single other book makes the over a slight favorite. A small usage bump erases the margin.","context_case":"The snapshot lists Cunningham as a game-time decision and multiple Pistons out. If Cunningham sits, Jenkins's usage likely rises, which works against the under. If he plays, the case survives but remains thin.","blocking_checks":["Cunningham's game-time decision. If he sits, Jenkins likely absorbs ball-handling and shots, pushing points plus rebounds above 18.5 and breaking the under."]},"countercase":"Even with Cunningham active, Detroit's other absences may already inflate Jenkins's role beyond what the rolling sample captures. The mean projection is above the line, and only skew supports the under. One comparison book leans the other way.","open_checks":["Confirm Jenkins's starting or bench role once Detroit's lineup is posted before the 7:11 PM EST tip.","Reconfirm +110 at 18.5; check whether the line moves after Cunningham news.","Check whether Jenkins's recent minutes came with or without Cunningham."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"f5efef74c5700315c2a0","excerpt":"Detroit Pistons: Cade Cunningham (PG); Knee; Game Time Decision","interpretation":"If Cunningham is ruled out, Jenkins would likely gain usage and minutes, which would undercut the under. The listing is a snapshot, not a final decision.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"},{"source_id":"f5efef74c5700315c2a0","excerpt":"Detroit Pistons: Ebuka Okorie (PG); Oblique; Expected to be out until at least Nov 30","interpretation":"Another guard out could concentrate backcourt opportunity on Jenkins. The model ignores teammate absences, so this risk may be missing from its projection.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
